previous_statement: All-level near-isometry. By lem-extcb-four-corner-norm, there are universal K_norm<infinity and e_norm>0 such that, whenever e=rho+epsilon<=e_norm, every n and X satisfy (1-K_norm e)||X||<=||gamma_n(X)||<=(1+K_norm e)||X||. The assembled map and factorization are exactly those fixed in node #0, so the external result applies without changing maps at different amplification levels.
